044/**
045 * For planetkiller ("PK") related tasks.
046 * 
047 *      PK_CMD <action> <parameters>
048 */
049public class PK_CMD extends BaseCommandPlugin {
050
051        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
052                if (dialog == null) return false;
053                
054                OptionPanelAPI options = dialog.getOptionPanel();
055                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
056                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
057                CargoAPI cargo = pf.getCargo();
058                
059                
060                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
061                
062                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
063                if (memory == null) return false; // should not be possible unless there are other big problems already
064                
065//              MarketAPI market = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket();
066//              StarSystemAPI system = null;
067//              if (dialog.getInteractionTarget().getContainingLocation() instanceof StarSystemAPI) {
068//                      system = (StarSystemAPI) dialog.getInteractionTarget().getContainingLocation();
069//              }
070                                
071                if ("removePKDefenses".equals(action)) {
072                        return removePKDefenses(dialog, memory);
073                } else if ("convertSentinelToColony".equals(action)) {
074                        return convertSentinelToColony(text, cargo);
075                } else if ("rightPostToAcceptPK".equals(action)) {
076                        return rightPostToAcceptPK(dialog);
077                } else if ("rightPostToTellAboutSentinel".equals(action)) {
078                        return rightPostToTellAboutSentinel(dialog);
079                } else if ("giveExecutor".equals(action)) {
080                        giveExecutor(dialog, params, memoryMap);
081                } else if ("blowUpSindria".equals(action)) {
082                        MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
083                        market.getPlanetEntity().addTag(Tags.PLANET_NO_COLONIZATION);
084                        if (market != null && market.getPlanetEntity() != null) {
085                                SDResolution.removeFleetCommander(PersonalFleetScript.getFleet(PersonalFleetHoracioCaden.class));
086                                new PlanetExplosionScript(market.getPlanetEntity());
087                        }
088                }
089                
090                return false;
091        }
092
093
094        protected boolean convertSentinelToColony(TextPanelAPI text, CargoAPI cargo) {
095                //int crew = 100;
096                //cargo.removeCrew(crew);
097                //AddRemoveCommodity.addCommodityLossText(Commodities.CREW, crew, text);
098                // Crew removal handled in rules.
099                
100                PlanetAPI planet = RecoverAPlanetkiller.getTundra();
101                MarketAPI market = planet.getMarket();
102                
103                //market.addTag(Tags.MARKET_NO_OFFICER_SPAWN);
104
105                market.setSurveyLevel(SurveyLevel.FULL);
106                for (MarketConditionAPI mc : market.getConditions()) {
107                        mc.setSurveyed(true);
108                }
109                
110                market.setName(planet.getName());
111                planet.setFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY);
112                
113                market.setDaysInExistence(0);
114                market.setPlanetConditionMarketOnly(false);
115                market.setFactionId(Factions.HEGEMONY);
116                market.addCondition(Conditions.POPULATION_3);
117                market.addIndustry(Industries.POPULATION);
118                market.addIndustry(Industries.FARMING);
119                
120                market.setSize(3);
121                
122                market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN);
123                market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK);
124                market.addSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_STORAGE);
125                //((StoragePlugin)market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_STORAGE).getPlugin()).setPlayerPaidToUnlock(true);
126                
127                market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN).getPlugin().updateCargoPrePlayerInteraction();
128                market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN).getPlugin().getCargo().clear();
129                if (market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN).getPlugin().getCargo().getMothballedShips() != null) {
130                        market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_OPEN).getPlugin().getCargo().getMothballedShips().clear();
131                }
132                market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK).getPlugin().updateCargoPrePlayerInteraction();
133                market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK).getPlugin().getCargo().clear();
134                if (market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK).getPlugin().getCargo().getMothballedShips() != null) {
135                        market.getSubmarket(Submarkets.SUBMARKET_BLACK).getPlugin().getCargo().getMothballedShips().clear();
136                }
137                
138                market.getTariff().modifyFlat("default_tariff", market.getFaction().getTariffFraction());
139                
140                planet.setMarket(market);
141                market.setPrimaryEntity(planet);
142                market.setPlayerOwned(false);
143                
144                Global.getSector().getEconomy().addMarket(market, false);
145                Global.getSector().getEconomy().tripleStep();
146                market.advance(0f);
147                market.getConstructionQueue().addToEnd(Industries.SPACEPORT, 0);
148                
149                //market.getConditions();
150                
151                SharedData.getData().getMarketsWithoutTradeFleetSpawn().add(market.getId());
152                
153                PersonAPI skiron = People.getPerson(People.SKIRON);
154                market.setAdmin(skiron);
155                market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(skiron, 0);
156                market.addPerson(skiron);
157                
158                market.getPrimaryEntity().setInteractionImage("illustrations", "sentinel2");
159
160                return true;
161        }
162
163
164
165        protected void giveExecutor(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
166                boolean removeSpecial = params.get(1).getBoolean(memoryMap);
167                
168                ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant("executor_Hull").clone();
169                v.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
170                v.setHullVariantId(Misc.genUID());
171                if (removeSpecial) {
172                        v.addSuppressedMod(HullMods.ANDRADA_MODS);
173                }
174                FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, v);
175                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
176                AddShip.addShipGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel());
177        }
178
179
180        protected boolean rightPostToAcceptPK(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
181                PersonAPI person = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
182                if (person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(LuddicPathBaseIntel.PATHER_BASE_COMMANDER)) {
183                        return true;
184                }
185                return Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
186                                   Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
187                                   //Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR.equals(person.getPostId()) || // just military, no regular admins
188                                   Ranks.POST_OUTPOST_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId());
189        }
190        
191        protected boolean rightPostToTellAboutSentinel(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
192                PersonAPI person = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getActivePerson();
193                return Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
194                                Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
195                                Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR.equals(person.getPostId()) ||
196                                Ranks.POST_OUTPOST_COMMANDER.equals(person.getPostId());
197        }
198        
199        protected boolean removePKDefenses(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, MemoryAPI memory) {
200                CampaignFleetAPI defenders = memory.getFleet("$defenderFleet");
201                if (defenders != null) {
202                        memory.unset("$defenderFleet");
203                        memory.set("$defenderFleetDefeated", true);
204                        memory.set("$hasDefenders", false, 0);
205                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().getContainingLocation().addEntity(defenders);
206                        defenders.setAI(null);
207                        defenders.setNullAIActionText("dormant");
208                        Vector2f loc = dialog.getInteractionTarget().getLocation();
209                        defenders.setLocation(loc.x, loc.y + 100f);
210                        defenders.setCircularOrbit(dialog.getInteractionTarget().getOrbitFocus(), 90f, 100f, 20f);
211                        defenders.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$pkDefenderFleet", true);
212                        defenders.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.FLEET_IGNORED_BY_OTHER_FLEETS, true);
213                        defenders.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_NO_SHIP_DERELICTS_IN_POST_BATTLE_DEBRIS, true);
214                        //Misc.addDefeatTrigger(defenders, "PK14thDefeated"); // handled elsewhere so the trigger is set in all cases
215                        Misc.makeNoRepImpact(defenders, "pk");
216                }
217                return true;
218        }
